description: ⚠️ ELEVATED COST: consumes 9x the quota of a single search_leads call. Only use this when the user explicitly wants more results than a regular search_leads call returned for one city, or asks to exhaustively cover a city — never as a default or first attempt; always try search_leads first. Tiles the given city into a 3x3 grid of sub-searches server-side to go beyond the normal ~20-60 result ceiling and return up to ~180 deduplicated businesses in one city. Requires an exact city name only (not the free-text query or industry) — passing a full sentence instead of a city name can cause it to geocode the wrong place and return zero results. Does not support pagination. Read-only: it never saves, creates, updates, or deletes leads.

city.description: City or region to search in, e.g. "Berlin" or "Austin, TX". Must be ONLY the city name — do not pass the free-text query or industry words here, or the city may be geocoded incorrectly (e.g. resolving to a same-named town in the wrong country).

has_website.description: Only return businesses that have a website.

industry.description: Industry filter. One of the predefined categories.

lang.description: Result language as a BCP-47 tag, e.g. "en" or "pt-BR".

min_rating.description: Minimum rating (0-5) a business must have to be included.

open_now.description: Only return businesses that are currently open.

q.description: Free-text search query, e.g. "construction companies". Optional if industry is given.

verified_only.description: Only return businesses with a verified listing.

name: search_leads_advanced
